items.title: Should You Buy Amazon Stock For The Demand AWS Cannot Yet Serve?
items.summary: Amazon.com (AMZN) stock has returned 8.9% over the past twelve months and trades about 13% below its 52-week high. Its cloud arm spent those months doing something the share price has not reflected. AWS growth sped up again in Q2 2026, and the contracts queued up behind it kept building. The upside case for the stock rests almost entirely on turning that queue into revenue.

items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Faces Fresh AI Pressure After Industry Leaders Urge Slowdown
items.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS: GOOGL) is facing renewed scrutiny after major AI leaders urged a slowdown in advanced AI development in 2026. Executives from OpenAI and Anthropic, along with Elon Musk, publicly supported tighter safeguards on powerful AI systems that firms like Google are building. The coordinated appeal increases pressure on regulators to reassess how fast large tech platforms expand high impact AI capabilities. This industry wide call to slow advanced AI work is an important backdrop...
